description.zh:
数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致。
> 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en:
The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application.

>  Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。
- 调用解除全员禁言接口后，若是被单独禁言的，则依然是禁言状态，无法解除禁言。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
*   Before you call this operation, make sure that you have called the [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) operation to create an interactive messaging group.
*   If a user was muted by calling the AddLiveMessageGroupBand operation, the user remains muted even after you call the UnbanLiveMessageGroup operation.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live unban-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UnbanLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
